question: How do the three powers further differentiate into six cognitions?
premises: From the stirring form of those powers, six immaculate cognitions are declared.
These arise from the immersion of those same powers.
That immersion is expressed as the power of action.
inference: The three powers, stirred into action, differentiate into six immaculate modes of cognition.
plain_english: From the stirring of those powers, six immaculate cognitions are declared. They arise from the immersion of those same powers as the power of action.
